ExtremeUniformIsolation10.title: Base-10 extreme uniform lattice targets have a unique predecessor, for every overflow word
ExtremeUniformIsolation10.scope: In the single-position cut automaton (pair coefficient x, lower carry l, previous overflow digit y), for base 10 and EVERY Bool overflow word gs, the only closed trajectory over gs that ends in the uniform target (L2,c,Y2) = (0,0,0), resp. (1,1,9), is the constant one (x=0, resp. x=18), and that constant trajectory exists (unique_pred_zero, canon0_walk, unique_pred_top, canon18_walk). This is the base-10 instance, proved in Lean, of the paper proof in results/E2ExtremeUniformIsolation.md. Not claimed: reachability of these targets from the root, other bases, non-uniform lattices, or anything about a Lychrel number.
